item.text: {"summary":"Draft is broadly publishable, but the resolver/source wording should be tightened to avoid a fragile future newsroom URL and to reconcile the DOL first-print rule with the ledger ALFRED binding.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"resolver","severity":"warning","summary":"The draft names a specific future DOL release URL, https://www.dol.gov/newsroom/releases/eta/eta20260716, which may not be the stable canonical resolver link; the ledger sourceBinding instead names ALFRED/FRED ICSA advance vintage while the reasoning uses DOL as the official agency source.","actionRequested":"State the resolver as the first DOL ETA UI Weekly Claims Report advance SA Initial Claims figure for week ending July 11, 2026, released July 16, 2026, and either use a stable DOL claims archive/latest-report source or explicitly note that the catalog binding may mirror the first print via ALFRED ICSA with factor 0.001."}],"optionalSuggestions":["In the prior/update/interval step, name the exact historical sample size or date range consistently with the listed weekly-difference vector.","Consider saying explicitly that the 80% interval is symmetric around the point after rounding to whole thousands."]}
